_note: Copy to avia_config.json, which is gitignored, and set for this machine. Forward slashes: JSON reads a single backslash as an escape, so C:\Avia breaks. Paths below are the Dev PC convention; the workstation uses D:/assets and D:/data. Nothing here is read from a hardcoded path in code: config.py resolves ASSETS_DIR through AVIA_ASSETS, so a machine moves its assets by setting one variable.
